question: Which union territory of India has the highest population density per 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NCT of Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NCT of Delhi** has the highest population density among the union territories of India as per the 2011 census.
 
• The population density of NCT of Delhi is **11,297 persons per square kilometer**.
 
• Delhi is not only the capital city of India but also a significant hub for politics, commerce,
